'''Soul Trap''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] employed by [[Tenebrae]]&mdash;otherwise known as Darth Vitiate or Valkorion. The ability would manifest itself where the enemy was standing, and although the area of its effect was small, it would harm those standing in it. It generally resembled a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] with a [[Color/Legends|pink]] event horizon, though it was significantly smaller. Tenebrae made use of this during the fight that lead to his final [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught" />
